sources.entry: trailofbits-skills - Security skills for vulnerability detection, auditing, and testing.

Trail of Bits Security Skills by Trail of Bits - A very professional collection of over a dozen security-focused skills for code auditing and vulnerability detection. Includes skills for static analysis with CodeQL and Semgrep, variant analysis across codebases, fix verification, and differential code review.

summary.one_liner: A marketplace of Trail of Bits plugins and skills for AI-assisted security analysis, auditing, testing, and development, installable in Claude Code, Codex, or ChatGPT workspaces.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is a plugin marketplace grouping many security-focused skills by domain, including smart contract security, code auditing, malware analysis (YARA), verification, reverse engineering (DWARF), mobile security (Firebase APK scanning), and general development tooling. Code auditing plugins cover static analysis with CodeQL, Semgrep, and SARIF, variant analysis across codebases, differential review of code changes, C/C++ and Rust security review, and false-positive verification. Verification plugins cover constant-time side-channel analysis, mutation testing, property-based testing, regression hunting, and Lean 4 proof writing. Development plugins include code review walkthroughs, GitHub issue and PR triage, and Python and C++ best-practice guidance. The README is a plugin index with install instructions, not a single tool, so individual plugins are documented elsewhere.
use_cases: Auditing a codebase for security vulnerabilities with AI assistance
Writing and refining Semgrep rules for custom bug detection
Running CodeQL or Semgrep static analysis and parsing SARIF output
Finding similar vulnerabilities across a codebase after one is found
Reviewing code changes and git history for security issues
Checking smart contracts for vulnerabilities and state-changing entry points
notable: Curated set of security plugins grouped by domain, from smart contracts to reverse engineering
Works as a marketplace in Claude Code, Codex, and ChatGPT workspaces
Includes a trophy case of bugs found using the skills, such as a timing side-channel in ML-DSA signing
Plugins cover both auditing workflows and verification such as mutation testing and Lean 4 proofs
caveats: Individual plugins are described only in one-line summaries here; details live in each plugin's own documentation
ChatGPT workspace import needs agents/openai.yaml metadata (interface.display_name and short_description) for skills that include it, and failed imports need a re-sync after a fix
Contributing guidance points to AGENTS.md and make check, which the README does not detail further
keywords: find bugs in code with ai
